title: Chain and null-chain lifts of conformal geodesics for twistor CR manifolds over a conformal three-manifold
author: Taiji Marugame
work: The Fefferman Metric for Twistor CR Manifolds and Conformal Geodesics in Dimension Three
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs the Fefferman metric in a twistor-adapted coframe, identifies its null-geodesic equations with the conformal-geodesic equation, and handles the two distinct chain regimes through the global SO(3)-invariant frame realization. The metric/curvature construction and lift uniqueness are retained; the later total-torsion variational corollary is not counted.
